outline:
Discuss the theories and features of kinds of AC electric machines, including: (1)A Simple Loop in a Uniform Magnetic Field; (2) The Rotating Magnetic Field; (3) Induced Voltage and Torque in AC Machines; (4)Machine Power Flows and Losses; (5)Synchronous Generators; (6) Synchronous Motors; (7)Induction Motors.

探討各種電機特性及工作原理，內容包含：(1)均勻磁場之單一線圈 (2)旋轉磁場 (3)交流電機的感應電壓與轉矩(4)電機功率潮流及損失 (5)同步發電機 (6)同步電動機 (7)感應電動機 。
schedule:
Wk1: Course Introduction and Rules (課程簡介及上課規則)
Wk2~Wk4: AC Machinery Fundamentals(交流電機基本概念)
Wk5~Wk8: Synchronous Generators (同步發電機)
Wk9: Midterm Exam (期中考)
Wk10: Midterm Commentary & Synchronous Motors (期中考後試題檢討及同步電動機)
Wk11~Wk13: Synchronous Motors(同步電動機)
Wk14~Wk17: Induction Motors(感應電動機)
Wk18: Final Exam (期末考)
assessment: (一)．Midterm(期中考): 30%; (二)．Final(期末考): 35%;  (三)．Attendance, Discussion and so on(平時): 35%
